slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.11% to 7,718.94 today, led by a sharp drop in tech stocks after press coverage showed inflation came in at 3.7% annually in September, hotter than the 3.6% forecast. Higher inflation means the Federal Reserve is more likely to raise interest rates, which hurts growth stocks the most because their value depends on future profits that become worth less when rates rise. The VIX, which measures fear priced into the market, jumped 10.48% to 16.87. Gold fell 1.16%, silver dropped 5.64%, and Korea's stock market fell 5.46%. Tomorrow brings producer price data, retail sales numbers, and a speech from Fed Chair Warsh, any of which could move markets further.
